audience: sales and customer teams who keep their pipeline, companies, people and tasks in Attio

useCases.title: Review the sales pipeline and the stage of each deal
useCases.text: List the lists of the workspace, such as a sales pipeline. Query its entries to see the stage of each deal.

useCases.title: Find a company and its open tasks
useCases.text: Search records across the workspace by text. Then list the tasks, filtered to that record, to see what is still open.

useCases.title: Read the notes on a record before a call
useCases.text: Read one record with its attribute values. List the notes attached to that record.

useCases.title: Log the summary of a call as a note
useCases.text: Attach a new note with the summary to one record. The note changes CRM data.

useCases.title: Add a person and a follow-up task
useCases.text: Create a person record from its attribute values. Then create a task linked to that record. Both calls change CRM data.
